name: Curiosity
description: Curiosity sense (J8 purposeful curiosity, first build). Each chat turn of the main agent gets the principal's passion map and a contract: do the task first, then, when a passion comes up, research it, teach one step deeper and ask one deep question in a ✨ DEEPER section (drawn as its own yellow-bordered bubble in Tinker), and keep the map current. The map is a private markdown file in the workspace.

sessionPrefix.description: Session keys that get the sense. Default: agent:main:tinker:

maxProfileChars.description: How much of the map goes into each turn. Default 3500
